opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Scholarships

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within the farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries or are in a position to influence these industries. Applicants must be aged between 25 and 45 years. There is no requirement for academic qualifications. Applicants must be resident in the UK and hold a UK passport or be working directly for UK agriculture.
opportunities.summary: Nuffield Farming Scholarships are an opportunity for individuals to research topics of interest in farming, food, horticulture, forestry or any other countryside and ancillary industry. Scholars conduct their study tour anywhere in the world for a period of no less than 8 weeks. On return, they present their findings at the Nuffield Farming Conference.
